visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young adults, two women and one man, stand on a lit sidewalk at night. The man on the right wears a black t-shirt and cargo pants, the central woman wears a blue halter top and white trousers, and the woman on the left wears a black shirt and tan pants. They hold white paper cups and a small green bottle toward the camera, laughing and eventually squatting down low to the ground. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor venue with purple neon lighting and a metal mesh fence background. The trio toasts with clear cups filled with amber liquid. The central woman smiles and covers her face while her friends cheer. (3) In a dimly lit indoor setting, the group celebrates again. The central woman appears heavily intoxicated, bending over forward until her head is near her knees while her friends laugh and cheer around her. Digital loading icons are edited over her to emphasize her state.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with high-energy Phonk music featuring heavy bass and sharp electronic transients. Three distinct voices—one male, two female—shout 'This is our first cup!' in Mandarin with high arousal and excitement. This is followed by loud group laughter and a squishing sound as they move. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a new phase. The voices excitedly announce the second round. The BGM remains constant but the vocal intensity increases with sharper pitch peaks. (3) Another digital transition stinger introduces the third phase. The group cheers loudly, but one female voice sounds noticeably more breathless and chaotic. A digital UI 'loading' sound effect is introduced as the BGM continues to pulse, highlighting the comedic intoxication shown on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: First Round -> Second Round -> Third Round (Final State)
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously document the rapid decline in sobriety among a group of friends over three rounds of drinks, following a popular social media challenge format.
